cover_headline: Indian IT Stocks Plunge Up to 5% as Global AI Rally Resumes
facts: Mphasis and Infosys fell about 5% each, and the Nifty IT index fell more than 3%
Across the two sessions, Infosys has shed about ₹25,000 crore in market capitalisation
SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold increase in quarterly profit, Samsung gained nearly 9% and the Kospi rose 6%

end.headline: Indian IT Stocks Plunge Up to 5% as Global AI Rally Resumes
end.line: Infosys has shed about ₹25,000 crore in market value over two sessions as the global AI trade rebound extends the sell-off in Indian software shares.
